# P34.36 — Release-search states (empty, errors, scope counts, pager)

**Requirement ids cited (context, not owned):** SIG-FIND-003 · SIG-UI-040 ·
SIG-UI-050. DR-C4-05/09/10 are agent drafts (R10_PREVIEW §3.4/3.5/8/9), not
spec ids. Owns S1 F-154 at the fixture layer (public with P35.63).
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/244_P34.36__release-search-states.md`
(manifest row 244, Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) · **Base:**
`r11/P34.35-research-dossier-disclosure` · **Gate:** none ·
**Live stage:** none (`live_verification=false`; release search goes live
with P35.63, Q-9) · **Production mutations:** none · **OM-20:** not an
OM-20 row · **CI config changed:** no.

## Why

The release-namespaced search did not tell the truth in every state: the
empty page claimed a "recorded absence" (asserting research status the
query cannot establish — C4 NEW-4, F-154), an HTML client got a JSON body
on every error (NEW-13), the scope counts ignored the records the current
policy withholds at access time (NEW-12), the pager hard-coded "next 50"
whatever the limit (NEW-28), pseudo-compartments like `web` answered a
readiness 503 as if an index could warm up (NEW-29), and a zero-record
release claimed `complete` completeness. Each defect is reproduced as a
failing test on the base before its fix — the red half is recorded in
`docs/build/runs/P34.36.md` (9 + 11 + 2 failures at `e33308eb`).

## What ships

- **Empty copy scoped to the query** (`exports/release_pages.py::
  search_page`): "No released record in this compartment matches." —
  never research status, never a recorded absence, never a failed-query
  claim (DR-C4-05).
- **HTML errors for HTML clients** (`api/app.py` +
  `release_pages.py::search_error_page`): the `SearchIndexError` handler
  negotiates on `format=html` / `Accept: text/html`; a search-scoped
  `RequestValidationError` handler renders the same HTML 422 (e.g.
  `limit=abc`) and delegates to the framework default for every other
  route. The error page states status, code, detail and — on 410 — the
  public-safe tombstone fields; it carries **no** "immutable release"
  stamp and no licence line. The renderer's status table covers
  400/404/409/410/422/429/503; the route today emits 404/409/410/422/503
  (429 is P36.13 scope). JSON clients keep the `{detail, code, …}` body
  byte-for-byte, Retry-After included.
- **Scope counts include access-time denials** (`search_index.py::search`
  + `release_search.py::_denied_targets`): the `denied` callable now
  answers the public-safe reason category (tombstone vocabulary) or a
  falsy value; a bounded pass over the whole `records` table under the
  same 2 s deadline lowers `eligible_records` and merges the denials into
  `excluded_records_by_reason`. `indexed_records` stays the pinned index
  truth; denials are still filtered before pagination, so pages stay
  dense; exhaustion answers 503, never a partial scope. A legacy bool
  predicate still works (counts under `denied`).
- **Pager + copy** (`search_page`): "next {limit} →" from the actual
  limit (cursor links keep query, filters and limit); the footer's
  duplicated static-browse sentence is dropped; facet options and the
  location column humanise display labels (`public-point` → "public
  point", `unreported` → "not reported") while `value=` wire tokens stay
  raw.
- **Non-data compartments not searchable** (`release.py` +
  `release_search.py`): `_NON_RECORD_COMPARTMENTS` becomes the public
  `NON_RECORD_COMPARTMENTS`; `metadata`/`web`/`web_mixed`/`code`/
  `ontology` answer 404 `compartment_not_searchable` before the
  comp-dir probe; `build_release` fails closed if a non-record
  compartment ever carries `sites.jsonl`.
- **Completeness at 0 records** (`release.py` + `release_landing`):
  `completeness.state` is `not_evaluable` (with a plain detail) when the
  release carries no records, else `complete`; the landing humanises the
  state ("not evaluable"). Validation vocabulary is untouched.
